page.layout: One printed page (left-hand page of the opening) with a running title and heading at top, then one column of index entries, a catchword "METHO-" at lower right, and a decorative ornament below. Right edge shows part of the facing page (margin fragments), not transcribed as text of this page.

main_text.head: INDEX CAPITVM IN SYNOPSI OECONOMICA CONTENTORUM.
main_text.l: 2. De societate coniugali, quæ est inter maritum & vxorem.
3. De secunda societate œconomica, quæ est inter parentes & liberos.
4. De societate inter dominum & seruum; siue inter herum & famulum.
5. De accidentaria, deq; secundaria ac imperfecta societate œconomica.
8. De cura, administratione & conseruatione partarum, siue acquisitarum possessionum domesticarum.
9. In quo delineatio œconomicæ prudentiæ specialis.

page.notes: The catchword "METHO-" is set at the lower right of the column and is given as a catchword/line-end fragment. Printed ornaments (a head border and a small cross-shaped fleuron) are not transcribed. Leftmost and rightmost edges show the facing page's margin text, which is not part of this page's transcription. The numbering in the entries is printed as 1., 2., etc. with the marks as they appear.
